verbs.name: orchestrate.new
verbs.help: Create a workspace (new branch from this shell's) and open a slcode session there; the session gets that role's guide

args.name: branch
args.help: branch name of the new workspace

args.name: preset
args.help: model preset from the assign setting: high | low | coordinate | refactor | review (default: coordinate for a role that starts other roles, else high)

verbs.name: orchestrate.message
verbs.help: Send a message to a session this session started

verbs.name: orchestrate.enter
verbs.help: Set this session's role and print the role names and its guide as JSON (the slcode session start hook and /superlite:roleas call it)

args.name: role
args.help: role to set; without it only the names

verbs.name: worker.sync
verbs.help: Bring the parent branch's latest work into this workspace

verbs.name: worker.message
verbs.help: Send a message to the session that started this one

verbs.name: worker.done
verbs.help: Finish this workspace: --submit merges into the parent, --close removes it, both do both, --abandon <key> discards and removes

args.name: submit
args.help: merge into the parent (needs --message and a session with a role)

args.name: close
args.help: remove this workspace and close this session; refused if anything is left unmerged

args.name: abandon
args.help: discard unmerged work and remove this workspace (key from a refused --close)

verbs.name: ticket
verbs.description: Ticket and milestone store for orchestration. Run `superlite ticket --help` for subcommands.
verbs.help: Ticket commands: new, ls, show, set, edit, log, done, drop, milestone, root. superlite ticket lists them with one line each; superlite ticket <command> --help explains its arguments

verbs.name: ticket.new
verbs.help: Create a ticket and print its id

args.name: todo
args.help: what to implement, short enough to reuse in a commit message

args.name: reason
args.help: why, the chosen direction and dropped alternatives

verbs.name: ticket.ls
verbs.help: List tickets (unfinished ones unless --status says otherwise)

args.name: status
args.help: open | active | hold | done | dropped, comma-separated, or all

args.name: milestone
args.help: tickets in this milestone, with what they depend on

verbs.name: ticket.show
verbs.help: Show a ticket: fields, todo, reason, log, dependencies and the commits with its Ticket: trailer

verbs.name: ticket.set
verbs.help: Change a ticket: title= status= priority= lane=, assignee+= depends+= repo+= (or -=); --todo and --reason replace the text

verbs.name: ticket.edit
verbs.help: Open the ticket's title, todo and reason as markdown in the editor; each save updates the ticket

verbs.name: ticket.log
verbs.help: Add a progress line to a ticket, signed with this folder's branch

verbs.name: ticket.done
verbs.help: Mark a ticket done; a ticket in no milestone joins the next open milestone

verbs.name: ticket.milestone
verbs.help: Milestones: new <title> --order <n> [--goal <text>] | ls | show <id> | add <id> <ticket...> | remove <id> <ticket...> | release <id>

args.name: action
args.help: new | ls | show | add | remove | release

args.name: order
args.help: for new: lower comes first, unique

args.name: goal
args.help: for new: what this milestone is for

verbs.name: ticket.root
verbs.help: Print the ticket DB this folder uses and where that came from (TICKET_PATH or a .ticket file)

settings.title: Orchestration
settings.description: superlite orchestrate new <role> <branch> [--preset <name>] -- <prompt>, superlite worker sync|done|message; roles are edited from the Orchestration sidebar — needs git 2.38 or later on the session machine and the slcode plugin; values are stored on the session machine

items.label: Preset assignment (JSON)
items.description: preset → model, e.g. {"high": "anthropic:opus", "low": "openai:gpt-5.6-sol"}. The anthropic: or openai: prefix picks the vendor. Unknown presets are rejected. Empty uses the built-in table
